name: claude-observatory-monorepo
description: Standalone, git-free, per-edit Keep/Undo for Claude Code on established and mission-critical codebases — terminal, VS Code and JetBrains, zero extra tokens.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @claude-observatory/core && npm run build -w claude-observatory
scripts.test: npm run version:check && npm run check:privacy && npm run check:webview && npm run build && npm run build:vscode && node --test packages/core/test/core.test.js packages/vscode/test/smoke.test.js
